We need to determine the charge(s). Facts: a health supervision officer (行政执法人员) failed to transfer cases of illegal medical practice (非法行医) to judicial authorities, instead gave administrative penalties, allowing continued illegal practice, for economic benefit. This is abuse of power and failure to transfer criminal cases. The relevant crime in Chinese law: “徇私舞弊，徇私枉法” maybe “徇私枉法罪”。 Also possibly “玩忽职守罪” (neglect of duty) or “滥用职权罪”. The description: as a health administrative law enforcement officer, he did not transfer criminal cases, which should be handed to judicial organs, and allowed continued illegal activity. This is a typical charge of “徇私枉法罪” (abuse of power to pervert the administration of justice). Under Chinese criminal law, article 397? Actually article 397 is “徇私枉法罪” for state functionaries who pervert the administration of justice. Also “玩忽职守罪” for negligence. Which fits better? The facts emphasize he deliberately did not transfer, for personal gain, to meet economic tasks. That's intentional, not negligence. So charge: “徇私枉法”. The instruction: when listing the charge, output only the crime name without suffix “罪”. So we output “徇私枉法”. Also need to consider if there is also “滥用职权” but that is for exceeding authority. Here he is a law enforcement officer, using his authority to not transfer. That is perverting justice. So likely only one charge: 徇私枉法.
